ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Thread Creation Via PowerShell In Uncommon Target
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a remote thread from a Powershell process in an uncommon target process Note: Unmapped fields: SourceImage, TargetImage

sequences.query: ((SourceImage = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$")))
